verdict.rationale: Omnara documents an official TypeScript SDK plus a REST API (with published OpenAPI spec) and CLI, giving AI-native users a concrete way to build against it programmatically (omnara-docs-2, omnara-docs-14, omnara-probe-2). However, evidence only shows one language SDK (TypeScript), no Python/other SDKs, no code examples or independent developer corroboration of SDK usage beyond docs. missing for 10: multi-language SDK coverage, third-party/hands-on validation of SDK usage, richer SDK reference docs.
